items.name: Seedance 2.5
items.description: Seedance 2.5 text-to-video, multimodal omni-reference generation, video edit, and video extension

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Generation mode: 't2v' for prompt-only generation, 'omni_reference' for image, video, or audio references, 'video_edit' to edit one reference video (billed by that video's duration; 'duration' and 'aspect_ratio' are ignored), or 'video_extension' to extend a reference video ('aspect_ratio' is ignored — the output follows the extended video).

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Duration in seconds (4-30). Whole number.

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Output resolution.

parameters.name: generate_audio
parameters.description: Generate audio for the output video.

parameters.name: bitrate_mode
parameters.description: 'standard' = normal output bitrate; 'high' = higher bitrate output.

parameters.name: extension_mode
parameters.description: Extension direction; required for mode 'video_extension' and not allowed otherwise.

parameters.name: draft
parameters.description: Generate a 480p draft that can be finalized within seven days.

parameters.name: draft_job_id
parameters.description: Completed draft job to finalize at the selected resolution. The final renders the draft's full duration and is billed for it; 'duration' is ignored.

medias.name: medias
medias.description: Media roles: start_image — First frame of the output video (mode 'omni_reference' only). | end_image — Last frame of the output video (mode 'omni_reference' only). | image_references — Reference images for subject, style, or composition (max 30 across image_references + start_image + end_image). (array, max 30) | video_references — Reference video clips (max 10). (array, max 10) | audio_references — Reference audio clips (max 10). (array, max 10)

items.purpose: Default video model: general text-to-video and image-to-video, multi-shot continuity.

items.name: Seedance 2.0
items.description: Reference-driven video with image/video/audio reference inputs, consistent identity, multi-SKU; optional generate_audio for native audio

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Duration in seconds (4-15). Whole number.

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Output resolution. 4k/1080p require mode='std'; mode='fast' supports 480p/720p only.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: 'std' = higher quality, supports 480p/720p/1080p/4k, requires a Plus plan or higher (Pro on legacy plans); 'fast' = cheaper/faster, supports 480p/720p only, available from the Basic/Starter plan.

parameters.name: bitrate_mode
parameters.description: 'standard' = normal output bitrate; 'high' = higher bitrate output.

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: Cinematic genre hint.

parameters.name: generate_audio
parameters.description: Generate native audio for the video. Set false for a silent video. Independent of audio_references.

medias.name: medias
medias.description: Media roles: start_image — First frame of the output video. | end_image — Last frame of the output video. | image_references — Generic reference images (style, composition, subject). At most 9 across image_references + start_image + end_image. (array) | video_references — Reference video clips (2-15s each, max 3). (array) | audio_references — Reference audio clips (2-15s each, max 3; require at least one image or video reference). (array)

items.purpose: Native 4K video, only when the user explicitly asks for true 4K.

items.name: MAGI-2
items.description: MAGI-2 video with native audio from text, a first frame, first and last frames, or image, video and audio references

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Output duration in seconds (4-30). Whole number.

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Output resolution. Only 1080p is available.

parameters.name: generate_audio
parameters.description: Generate an audio track with the video.

parameters.name: enhance_prompt
parameters.description: Let the model rewrite the prompt before generating.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Seed for a repeatable result. Omit for a random one. Whole number.

medias.name: medias
medias.description: Media roles: start_image — First frame. Cannot be combined with reference media. | end_image — Last frame. Requires start_image. | image_references — Up to 10 reference images. (array, max 10) | video_references — Up to 5 reference videos, 2-30 seconds each and 30 seconds in total. (array, max 5) | audio_references — Up to 5 reference audio clips, 2-30 seconds each and 30 seconds in total. (array, max 5)

items.purpose: Lower-cost video with native audio from text, first/last frames, or image, video and audio references. Fixed output resolution, slower renders.

items.name: Genjutsu
items.description: Transfer motion from a reference video to subjects in reference images

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Output resolution: 480p, 720p, or 1080p.

medias.name: medias
medias.description: Media roles: image_references — Reference images containing the subjects to animate (1-49). (array, max 49) | video_references — Reference video supplying the motion to transfer. Exactly one is required. (array, max 1)

items.purpose: Genjutsu motion transfer: a reference video drives the subjects of reference images.

items.name: Genjutsu Lite
items.description: Transfer motion from a reference video to subjects in reference images (MAGI-2, 1080p, up to 30 seconds)

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Output resolution: 1080p.

medias.name: medias
medias.description: Media roles: image_references — Reference images containing the subjects to animate (1-10). (array, max 10) | video_references — Reference video supplying the motion to transfer. Exactly one is required; output is capped at 30 seconds. (array, max 1)

items.purpose: Genjutsu Lite motion transfer: a reference video drives the subjects of reference images.

parameters.description: Output resolution (higher = more credits)

parameters.name: genre

parameters.name: slow_motion

parameters.name: genre
parameters.description: Video genre/style

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Quality mode: pro or standard

parameters.name: sound
parameters.description: Generate audio. Use 'off' for a silent video.

parameters.name: speedramp
parameters.description: Speed-ramp time effect (slowmo, speedup, etc.).

parameters.name: multi_shots
